title: Insecure Data Sharing
description: The parent user may inadvertently share sensitive information (email, password, name, govt ID) in an insecure manner, leading to unauthorized access or data breaches.

title: Data Interception
description: Data in transit (registration information) could be intercepted by malicious actors, leading to unauthorized access to personal information.

title: Improper Data Storage
description: The Authentication Service may store sensitive user data (email, password, name, govt ID) insecurely, making it vulnerable to data breaches.

title: Unintended Data Disclosure
description: The Authentication Service may unintentionally disclose sensitive user information to unauthorized parties due to misconfigurations or inadequate access controls.

title: Inadequate Authentication Mechanism
description: The authentication service may have weak authentication mechanisms that can be exploited, leading to unauthorized access to the parent account.

title: Data Breach due to Insecure Storage
description: The MongoDB users collection may not have adequate security measures in place, leading to potential data breaches and unauthorized access to sensitive parent account information.

title: Interception of Data in Transit
description: Data being transmitted from the authentication service to the MongoDB users collection may be intercepted by malicious actors, leading to unauthorized access to sensitive information.

title: Data Leakage through JWT
description: The authentication service may inadvertently expose sensitive user data embedded in the JWT if proper encryption or signing mechanisms are not implemented.

title: Insecure Storage of JWT
description: The parent user may store the JWT insecurely, leading to unauthorized access if the token is compromised.

title: Network Eavesdropping
description: The JWT and user data may be intercepted during transmission if not properly secured with encryption.

title: Improper Data Handling by Parent User
description: The parent user may mishandle the received data, leading to unintended disclosure or misuse.

title: Insecure Data Sharing
description: The child user shares sensitive information (parent email and password) which could be intercepted by an unauthorized party during transmission.

title: Data Linkability
description: The data flow may allow for linkability between the child user and their parent, potentially exposing the parent's identity.

title: Unauthorized Access to Data
description: The authentication service may store or process the parent email and password insecurely, leading to unauthorized access.

title: User Consent Issues
description: The child user may not fully understand or consent to the data being shared with the authentication service.

title: Insufficient Authentication Mechanism
description: The authentication service may not implement strong enough mechanisms to verify the identity of the child user, leading to unauthorized access to sensitive child profiles.

title: Inadequate Data Protection at Destination
description: Once the child user receives the JWT and profiles, there may be insufficient measures in place to protect this data from unauthorized access or disclosure.

title: Data Leakage in Transit
description: The JWT and child profiles may be intercepted during transmission, leading to potential exposure of sensitive information.

title: Improper Data Storage Practices
description: The child profiles may be stored insecurely by the child user, increasing the risk of data breaches or unauthorized access.

title: Unintended Data Sharing
description: The authentication service may inadvertently share more information than intended about the child user, leading to privacy violations.

title: Inadequate Consent
description: The parent user may not have provided adequate consent for the collection of sensitive information about the child, such as government ID and date of birth.

title: Data Breach Risk
description: The child profile management process may be vulnerable to data breaches, exposing sensitive information such as name, DOB, gender, and government ID.

title: Interception of Data in Transit
description: The data being transmitted from the parent user to the child profile management process could be intercepted by unauthorized parties.

title: Data Retention Issues
description: The child profile management process may retain data longer than necessary, increasing the risk of unauthorized access or misuse.

title: Inadequate Consent Management
description: The process may not adequately manage consent from parents or guardians for storing and updating child profiles, leading to unauthorized data processing.

title: Data Breach Risk
description: The MongoDB childprofiles collection may be vulnerable to data breaches, exposing sensitive child profile information to unauthorized parties.

title: Inadequate Data Retention Policies
description: The data stored in the MongoDB collection may not have adequate retention policies, leading to unnecessary storage of personal data beyond its intended purpose.

title: Unintended Data Sharing
description: There is a risk that child profile data could be unintentionally shared with third parties due to misconfigurations or lack of access controls in the MongoDB database.

title: Informed Consent
description: The Child User may not fully understand or be informed about the data being shared with the Video Management Service, leading to a lack of informed consent.

title: Data Misuse
description: The Video Management Service may misuse the data collected from the Child User for purposes other than those originally intended, such as targeted advertising.

title: Data Linkability
description: Data in transit may be intercepted, allowing third parties to link the Child User's identity with their actions (searches, likes, comments) on the platform.

title: Data Retention
description: The Video Management Service may retain data longer than necessary, increasing the risk of unauthorized access or breaches.

title: Data Disclosure
description: The Video Management Service may inadvertently disclose personal data of the Child User through inadequate security measures.

title: Unauthorized Access to Video Metadata
description: An unauthorized user may gain access to the video metadata being shared by the Video Management Service, leading to potential privacy violations.

title: Insecure Storage of Video Files
description: The MongoDB videos collection may not have adequate security measures in place, leading to potential data breaches and unauthorized access to sensitive video files.

title: Data Retention Issues
description: The video metadata and files may be retained longer than necessary, leading to potential privacy concerns regarding the storage of personal data.

title: Inadequate Consent Management
description: The process may not adequately inform parents or guardians about the data being collected, leading to a lack of informed consent for storing child search and watch history.

title: Data Retention Risks
description: The MongoDB childprofiles collection may retain child search and watch history longer than necessary, increasing the risk of unauthorized access or misuse.

title: Insecure Data Storage
description: The child profiles stored in MongoDB may be vulnerable to unauthorized access if proper security measures are not implemented.

title: Lack of Anonymization
description: The data flow may not anonymize child search and watch history, making it possible to identify individual children from the stored data.

title: Inadequate Consent
description: The parent user may not fully understand or provide informed consent for the data being uploaded, leading to potential misuse of their personal information.

title: Data Leakage during Approval Process
description: During the approval or rejection process, there is a risk that sensitive information from the uploaded video could be inadvertently shared with unauthorized personnel.

title: Improper Data Retention
description: The Video Management Service may retain uploaded videos longer than necessary, increasing the risk of unauthorized access or data breaches.

title: Unencrypted Data Transmission
description: If the video upload is not encrypted during transmission, it could be intercepted by malicious actors, compromising the privacy of the parent user.

title: Unauthorized Access to Video Stream
description: The Video Management Service may inadvertently allow unauthorized users to access the video stream intended for the child user, leading to potential exposure of sensitive content.

title: Inappropriate Use of Video Content
description: The child user may misuse or share the video content with others, leading to privacy violations or exposure of sensitive information.

title: Data Leakage During Transmission
description: There is a risk of data leakage during the transmission of the video stream, which could expose metadata or content to unauthorized parties.

title: Unauthorized Data Sharing
description: The child browsing data may be shared without proper consent from guardians, leading to unauthorized access to sensitive information.

title: Inaccurate Data Processing
description: The AI Recommendation Engine may process child browsing data inaccurately, leading to inappropriate recommendations or actions based on misinterpreted data.

title: Data Retention Risks
description: The AI engine may retain child browsing data longer than necessary, increasing the risk of data breaches or misuse.

title: Network Eavesdropping
description: Data in transit between the MongoDB and the AI engine could be intercepted by unauthorized parties, leading to potential exposure of sensitive child data.

title: Inadequate Consent Mechanism
description: The AI Recommendation Engine may share browsing data with third-party advertisers without obtaining explicit consent from users, leading to unauthorized data sharing.

title: Insecure Data Storage
description: Third-party advertisers may store browsing data insecurely, making it vulnerable to unauthorized access or breaches.

title: Data Linkability
description: The browsing data being transmitted may contain identifiable information that allows third parties to link users to their browsing behavior, compromising user anonymity.

title: Misuse of Data
description: Third-party advertisers may use the browsing data for purposes beyond what was originally intended or communicated to users, leading to potential privacy violations.

title: Unauthorized Access to Government ID Images
description: An unauthorized user may gain access to the authentication service and submit a request to store government ID images, leading to potential data breaches.

title: Insecure Storage of Government ID Images
description: The file system may not have adequate security measures in place, leading to unauthorized access or data leaks of sensitive government ID images.

title: Data Leakage During Transmission
description: While transmitting government ID images from the authentication service to the file system, there is a risk of interception by malicious actors, leading to data leakage.

title: Insufficient Authentication Strength
description: The authentication service may use weak algorithms or insufficiently complex passwords, making it easier for attackers to gain unauthorized access to the JWT stored in localStorage.

title: Insecure Storage of JWT
description: Storing JWT in localStorage can expose it to cross-site scripting (XSS) attacks, where an attacker can access the token and impersonate the user.

title: Data Leakage through LocalStorage
description: The JWT stored in localStorage may be accessible to other scripts running on the same domain, leading to potential data leakage.

title: Unauthorized Access to JWT
description: If the localStorage is not properly secured, unauthorized users or scripts may gain access to the JWT, allowing them to perform actions on behalf of the user.

title: Unauthorized Access to Child Profile
description: A parent may gain unauthorized access to sensitive child profile information if proper authentication mechanisms are not in place.

title: Inadequate Data Handling by Parent
description: The parent may mishandle or improperly store the retrieved child profile information, leading to potential data leaks or unauthorized sharing.

title: Data Leakage During Transmission
description: There is a risk of data leakage during the transmission of child profile information to the parent, especially if the data flow is not encrypted.

title: Retention of Child Data
description: The parent may retain the child profile information longer than necessary, leading to potential misuse or unauthorized access.

title: Unclear Data Sharing Policies
description: The process may lack clear policies regarding data sharing, leading to misunderstandings about what information can be shared with the parent.
